title: 803.13 Application of interior finish materials to fire-resistance-rated or noncombustible building elements.

blocks.html: Where interior finish materials are applied on walls, ceilings or structural elements required to have a fire-resistance rating or to be of noncombustible construction, these finish materials shall comply with the provisions of this section.
